description: Foundation layer: chat-service.ts (types + Aksharamukha API + AI chat fetch), routes/chat.tsx (TanStack file-based route), .env.example, and unit tests for the service. No UI changes — these are the modules the UI component depends on.
steps: Create src/lib/chat-service.ts. Define and export: ChatScript ('devanagari'|'ranjana'), ChatLanguage ('nepal-bhasa'|'nepali'), ChatRole ('user'|'assistant'). Define ChatMode interface: { id:string, label:string, language:ChatLanguage, script:ChatScript, aksharaSource:string, aksharaTarget:string, fontClass:string }. Define ChatMessage interface: { id:string, role:ChatRole, text:string, displayText:string, fontClass:string, timestamp:number } — note fontClass stored per-message. Export CHAT_MODES as const array of 3 ChatMode objects: (1) { id:'nepal-bhasa-devanagari', label:'नेपाल भाषा — देवनागरी', language:'nepal-bhasa', script:'devanagari', aksharaSource:'Devanagari', aksharaTarget:'Devanagari', fontClass:'chat-font--devanagari' }, (2) { id:'nepali-ranjana', label:'नेपाली — रञ्जना लिपि', language:'nepali', script:'ranjana', aksharaSource:'Devanagari', aksharaTarget:'Ranjana', fontClass:'chat-font--ranjana' }, (3) { id:'nepal-bhasa-ranjana', label:'नेपाल भाषा — रञ्जना लिपि', language:'nepal-bhasa', script:'ranjana', aksharaSource:'Devanagari', aksharaTarget:'Ranjana', fontClass:'chat-font--ranjana' }. Export convertScript(text:string, source:string, target:string, signal?:AbortSignal): Promise<string> — if source===target return text immediately without fetching; build URL as new URL('https://aksharamukha.appspot.com/api/public') and set searchParams for source/target/text; on fetch error or non-ok response return original text (graceful degradation). Export sendChatMessage(userText:string, mode:ChatMode, history:ChatMessage[], signal?:AbortSignal): Promise<string> — read endpoint from import.meta.env['VITE_LIPIAI_CHAT_URL']; if falsy throw new Error('Chat is not connected yet.'); POST JSON body { message:userText, language:mode.language, history: history.map(m=>({role:m.role, text:m.text})) }; on non-ok response throw Error('The chat request failed. Please try again.'); cast json() to Record<string,unknown>, read reply field, validate typeof reply==='string' else throw Error('The chat returned an invalid response.'); return reply.

Create src/routes/chat.tsx following the exact pattern of src/routes/about.tsx. Import createFileRoute from '@tanstack/react-router' and ChatInterface from '@/components/chat-interface'. Export Route = createFileRoute('/chat')({ head: () => ({ meta: [ {title:'Chat — LipiAI'}, {name:'description', content:'Chat in Nepal Bhasa and Nepali with script conversion.'}, {property:'og:title', content:'Chat — LipiAI'}, {property:'og:type', content:'website'}, {name:'twitter:card', content:'summary_large_image'} ] }), component: ChatInterface }). Note: ChatInterface is created in FEAT-002; this file will cause a build error until FEAT-002 is complete — that is expected, the build verification step is at the end of FEAT-002.

Create frontend/.env.example with two documented variables: VITE_LIPIAI_CHAT_URL (receives {message,language,history} JSON body, returns {reply:string}) and VITE_LIPIAI_ANALYSIS_URL (receives multipart/form-data with 'image' field, returns {translation?,literal_translation?,summary}).

Create src/test/chat-service.test.ts following the pattern of src/test/inscription-analysis.test.ts. Use afterEach(()=>vi.unstubAllGlobals()). Tests: (a) convertScript returns original when source===target without calling fetch; (b) convertScript calls fetch with correct URL params and returns response text; (c) convertScript returns original text when fetch throws (graceful degradation); (d) sendChatMessage with empty endpoint throws 'Chat is not connected yet.'; (e) sendChatMessage success path — stub fetch to return {reply:'धन्यवाद'}, assert resolved value equals 'धन्यवाद'; (f) sendChatMessage invalid response (no reply field) — assert throws.
acceptance_criteria: npx vitest run src/test/chat-service.test.ts passes all 6 tests
CHAT_MODES array has exactly 3 entries with the correct ids, labels, and fontClass values
convertScript with equal source and target never calls fetch
sendChatMessage with no endpoint env var throws an error containing 'not connected'
frontend/.env.example exists and documents both VITE_ variables
src/routes/chat.tsx exists and imports ChatInterface (even if build fails until FEAT-002)
verification: npx vitest run src/test/chat-service.test.ts — all tests pass
findings: Exports: ChatScript, ChatLanguage, ChatRole (types), ChatMode, ChatMessage (interfaces), CHAT_MODES (const array of 3, satisfies ChatMode[]), convertScript(text,source,target,signal?), sendChatMessage(userText,mode,history,signal?,endpoint?). sendChatMessage accepts optional 5th param `endpoint` defaulting to import.meta.env['VITE_LIPIAI_CHAT_URL'] — mirrors inscription-analysis.ts pattern for testability. CHAT_MODES[0] = 'nepal-bhasa-devanagari', [1] = 'nepali-ranjana', [2] = 'nepal-bhasa-ranjana'. chat.tsx imports ChatInterface from '@/components/chat-interface' (unresolved until FEAT-002). All 6 tests pass.
